title: eugenia operculata var. cerasoides
intro: Eugenia operculata var. cerasoides, commonly known as Ceylon olive or mountain olive, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia operculata var. cerasoides include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight bacterial infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through various studies.
